title: Weather, Environment & Disaster
tagline: Hydromet, air quality, seismic, and disaster portals
description: DHM is authoritative but has no public REST API; AQICN and OpenAQ offer programmatic air-quality data. USGS FDSN is the de-facto API for Nepal earthquakes. BIPAD is the strongest official Nepali disaster API.

resources.name: Department of Hydrology and Meteorology (DHM)
resources.description: Authoritative Nepal weather/hydrology. No public REST API; data is paid + form-based. Toll-free 1155.

resources.name: AQICN Nepal
resources.description: Free air-quality API for Nepal monitoring stations (token-based).

resources.name: OpenAQ Nepal
resources.description: Free open air-quality data covering Nepal stations.

resources.name: NEMRC / Seismonepal
resources.description: National Earthquake Monitoring and Research Center. Updated quake list.

resources.name: USGS Earthquake Feed
resources.description: FDSN feed — de-facto API for Nepal earthquakes (filter by region).

resources.name: BIPAD Portal
resources.description: National Disaster Information Management System by NDRRMA + Youth Innovation Lab. Browsable Django REST API at /api.

resources.name: NDRRMA
resources.description: Nepal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority.

resources.name: DrivenData — Richter's Predictor
resources.description: ML competition dataset on 2015 earthquake building damage.

resources.name: QuakeMap.org
resources.description: Kathmandu Living Labs / Ushahidi 2015 quake response platform. Standby/historical.
